findings.title: Catalog reset to 11 upsell items only — no Sandwich Cayenne / Tacos / Bols / Big Cayenne
findings.detail: php artisan tinker SELECT MAX(id) FROM items returned 11 at run-start (2026-05-28). Mission brief specifies "Sandwich Cayenne via wizard" — currently impossible: only Menu (Frites + Boisson) id=1, Frites Seules id=2, Boisson Seule id=3, Sauce/Fromage/Jambon/Boursin/Raclette/Œuf/Galette/Salade (4–11) exist. Spec adapts via seeded fixtures using items 1/2/3 to drive cross-system propagation evidence. Run db:seed --class=LeCayenneMenuSeeder to restore catalog before any user-facing E2E.
findings.evidence: tinker MAX(id)=11; items table column listing confirmed (no category_id, only item_category_id); no Cayenne/Tacos/Bols names match

findings.title: orders table lacks ALL phone storage columns — GDPR DELIVERY phone gate has no path
findings.detail: php artisan tinker Schema::getColumnListing('orders') matched ['delivery_boy_id','delivery_charge','delivery_time','loyalty_customer_code'] for the regex /phone|mobile|delivery|address|contact|customer|meta/i. NO mobile_number / phone / delivery_address / order_meta column exists. Z9-P0-03 GDPR requirement = “DELIVERY orders MUST surface customer phone on KDS card, MUST NOT surface on OSS”. Without a storage column, the requirement is structurally unsatisfiable. Either (a) schema migration was rolled back, (b) customers normalized into customers/order_addresses, or (c) feature never implemented at this branch state.
findings.evidence: orders.columns = [actor_id, branch_id, business_date, delivery_boy_id, delivery_charge, delivery_time, discount, fiscal_sequence_no, id, idempotency_key, is_advance_order, loyalty_customer_code, order_datetime, order_serial_no, order_type, payment_method, payment_status, queue_number, source, source_surface, status, subtotal, token, total, total_tax, updated_at, user_id, ...]

findings.title: KDS queue saturated at 31 cards + 23 waiting — seeded order PA5B8 invisible inside cap
findings.detail: Visual evidence (screenshots/S1-03-kds-order-visible.png + S2-02-kds-initial.png): KDS banner reads “Liste pleine (31 affichée(s), max. serveur) : d'autres commandes actives existent peut-être — filtrez par statut ou cherchez un n° de ticket”. Counter “+23 en attente” top-right. All cards = “BORNE NOUVELLE” A0033…A0078, attente 70:00–71:50 (orders queued for >70 minutes). The seeded PA5B8 / GFCROSS-S1 order exists in DB at status=4 ACCEPT but the KDS surface caps the visible window. Real-world impact: a fresh paid POS order is invisible to kitchen if backlog >31 — customer waits, kitchen does not see ticket. Search box mentioned in banner but not used in test — deserves a 'recent first' or 'POS surface bias' sort to surface fresh orders. The +23 counter indicates server-side filter works; the 31-cap is a frontend display cap.
findings.evidence: screenshots/S1-03-kds-order-visible.png + S2-02-kds-initial.png + S2-03-kds-delivery-visible.png all show identical 31-cap banner

findings.title: OSS surface bounced 3rd admin context to /login mid-test
findings.detail: screenshots/S1-06-oss-screen.png URL ended on http://localhost:8000/login. The admin session opened concurrently with 2 other contexts (POS, KDS) was kicked back to the login form on OSS navigation, even though /admin/dashboard had loaded in the ensureAdmin() pre-step on the same context. Console produced 21 consecutive 401 Unauthorized errors immediately before. Possible root cause: SPA fetches /api/* with stale Sanctum cookie, gets 401, redirects router to /login. Triple-context fanout amplifies the race. NOTE: S2-04 OSS capture (later, dedicated context) DID render “Prêt N°PA5B8” in the ready column, so the cross-system chain DID propagate — the S1 assertion was a false negative caused by the auth race, not a chain break.

findings.title: KDS did not show seeded POS order GFCROSS-S1 within 15s (downstream of cap)
findings.detail: Order 123 (serial GFCROSS-S1-2026-05-28-A-62FC, queue PA5B8) status=4 PAID TAKEAWAY persisted in DB (attestation OK). KDS page text never contained the marker. Direct downstream effect of CROSS-KDS-QUEUE-CAP-OVERFLOW. Workaround would be to bump existing top-of-queue cards to PREPARED to free slots, or extend the KDS visible window above 31.

findings.title: KDS did not show seeded DELIVERY order GFCROSS-S2 within 15s
findings.detail: Order 125 order_type=5 (DELIVERY) PAID — KDS bodyText never contained marker. Same overflow root cause as S1, plus no phone column means even if visible the GDPR card would lack the phone.

findings.title: KDS DELIVERY card did not surface phone 0600000001 — storage gap blocks GDPR test
findings.detail: Z9-P0-03 GDPR phone gate states: DELIVERY orders MUST surface customer phone on KDS cards (deliverer needs it). The marker phone was attempted on columns mobile_number, phone, delivery_address, order_meta — phone_stored_on_cols = [] (NONE matched). The order was created with order_type=5 DELIVERY but no column accepted the phone. Combined with CROSS-KDS-QUEUE-CAP-OVERFLOW the card was not even visible. Cannot assert GDPR rule until DATA-SCHEMA-PHONE-COLUMNS-MISSING is resolved.

findings.title: S1 OSS PRÊT locator missed PA5B8 due to auth-bounce, not chain break
findings.detail: Asserted via 'role=region name=pret|ready' selector against PA5B8. Returned false. However in S2-04 capture (next test, fresh context, S1 order already PREPARED) the OSS DID render “N°PA5B8” in the right-side Prêt column. So the chain works — the S1 false negative is collateral damage from CROSS-OSS-AUTH-BOUNCE. Test resilience: re-arm auth on the OSS context before assertion.
findings.evidence: screenshots/S2-04-oss-delivery.png clearly shows “Prêt → N°PA5B8” on right column

findings.title: OSS did not show seeded DELIVERY order GFCROSS-S2 in PRÉPARATION column
findings.detail: S2-04 capture shows OSS “En préparation” column with only A0001, A0002, A0078. Our DELIVERY order D156F (status=4 ACCEPT, not yet PREPARED) was not surfaced. Either OSS filters DELIVERY out of En préparation column (intentional? not documented), or the queue_number 'D156F' format does not match the OSS regex/contract.
findings.evidence: screenshots/S2-04-oss-delivery.png En préparation column lacks D156F

findings.title: 21 console 401 Unauthorized errors in S1 during cross-context fanout
findings.detail: All 21 errors fired in a 1-second window 2026-05-28T17:13:23–24 immediately preceding the OSS auth bounce. Likely a barrage of /api/me or /api/preview/* fetches after Sanctum cookie partial-acceptance. Should be reproduced isolated and either (a) deduped client-side, or (b) fixed in middleware (return 200 with empty payload when partial-auth so SPA stays mounted).
